scope: One host-context read-only GPU/resource diagnostic only; P1/P2 execution remains subject to a later actual Astra runtime freeze.

problem.raw_stdout: NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Make sure that the latest NVIDIA driver is installed and running.

transitive_input_manifest.rule: ROOT rehash manifest and every listed input before diagnostic; manifest references retained originals, no mass copy.

hypotheses: H1: restricted execution prevents NVIDIA device/driver access; host context may succeed.
H2: actual host driver/device is unavailable.
Both are unconfirmed; a successful host observation supports context-dependent access but does not prove the exact sandbox mechanism.
authorization: User explicitly requested 开始真实运行; this minimal diagnostic needs no additional user confirmation loop. Tool escalation still goes through its own approval reviewer.
preconditions: ROOT verifies input hashes and baseline/product-stage invariance; no concurrent workload startup.
ROOT prepares a new non-overwriting evidence destination and persists plan hashes plus exact command before execution.
Exactly one exec_command with sandbox_permissions=require_escalated; use command verbatim.
No invocation of model, renderer, engine, API or workload runner.

diagnostic.justification: 为用户已授权的真实运行做一次只读 GPU/驱动/既有 Qwen 服务状态诊断，区分受限环境访问问题与主机驱动问题。不会启动或停止服务、模型或渲染。
diagnostic.capture: ROOT saves outer stdout/stderr/rc and UTC/context separately; decode each stdout_b64/stderr_b64 into exact raw bytes; never rewrite original intake.

classification.HOST_OBSERVATION_AVAILABLE: Both nvidia-smi queries rc0 with parsable finite memory values, nonempty GPU listing; this records observation access only.
classification.RESOURCE_CLEAR_AT_SNAPSHOT: HOST_OBSERVATION_AVAILABLE plus compute list empty, Qwen loaded/inactive/dead/MainPID=0/ControlPID=0, memory recorded and no contradictory ownership evidence. Does not allocate/reserve GPU or prove sufficient workload VRAM.
classification.RESOURCE_BUSY: GPU accessible but compute entries, active/deactivating Qwen, or unexplained memory/ownership; preserve identities from limited metadata and stop before workloads. No automatic kill/stop.
classification.UNRESOLVED: Host query failure, timeout, approval rejection, invalid/missing metadata or service result, unrecognized state, PID turnover, or ownership incomplete; preserve raw evidence and stop affected work, actual Astra next round before new repair/retry.

prohibited: Product/test changes; changes to R461/R465 or other frozen originals.
Reboot, driver/module/package changes, service start/restart/stop, kill of existing processes.
Reading process environment, cmdline, secrets, profile contents, credential files, runtime database, weights or SDK contents.
Additional software tests or actual workload/API/physics/render/resource allocations.
Claiming native VALID, online qualification or formal acceptance.
root_steps: S0 Revalidate pins/source context and archive the exact command and plan SHA.
S1 Execute exactly one host read-only command and preserve all raw results, including failures.
S2 Compare restricted rc9 versus new host result side-by-side; classify access, memory, compute ownership and service state separately.

S3 Write implementation/step-report.md and .json containing steps, timestamps, command/result SHA, original/new rc, classification, deviations, all zero workload counters and next boundary; merge into phase summary without changing original evidence.

S4 Only if resource snapshot permits, ask actual Astra to freeze fresh source generation and exact P1/P2 runner commands/budgets; GPU stages serial, P2 independent of P1 success. User authorization already exists.

planning_tool_note.impact: Read-only intake listing alias absent; no product/environment repair. Actual Astra selected existing python3 for reading/writing planning artifacts and explicitly freezes /usr/bin/python3 for ROOT diagnostic. No GPU diagnostic executed.
